content: Ukwà a Ywan
Utaaŋ alan, Ɛlɔdi, kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r a Ngalilɛ, kàwem nde làkoo a Yɛsu,
nde kàtɛn a asyääl ande naa: « Wawɛy Ywan Un'düümà kan'wiyà uboo a akü! Undiir awun awà nde anà ikɔ̈b mukyer impà! »
Yàmɛnà naa Ɛlɔdi kàswɛŋ baar mukɔr Ywan, mukun'bäm dwaaŋ anà mukun'biil u bɔlokà. Ntɔn kàwɛl nde Ilɔdyas, un'kyay a un'tɔŋ ande Filipo.
Ntɔn Ywan kàtɛɛnà a nde naa: « Ikwe anki naa ngye un'wɛl un'kyay! »
Itàkal naa Ɛlɔdi kàkwen mudwa Ywan, nde kàtiinà un'sɛŋ a baar bɔɔmà ntɔn ba Ywan bàfun'walà asànaa ŋangɔɔm.
Apan, kilä a un'kyɔm a mböör a Ɛlɔdi, mwan a Ɛlɔdyadi wà un'kaar kàyàkyen kusà a baar kàbel nde, un'sak laa kàwɛl wa Ɛlɔdi.
Undiir awun, kàdi nde kyän mukun'pà undiir wanswà kàlun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m nde.
Apan, u nswɛɛŋ a ngwän, nde kàtɛn a Ɛlɔdi naa: « Mpɛ un'tswe a Ywan Udüümà, apà, udu a làlɔŋà! »
Mfum kàwɛm ngyɛb ntɔn ya. Wɛɛ ntɔn kyän ande anà baar kàbel nde, nde kàswɛŋ naa bun'pɛ wa.
Nde kàtöm baar mukàtsul Ywan un'tswe u bɔlokà.
Ba bàtwääl un'tswe a Ywan udu a làlɔŋà, waa bàpɛ wa akà mwan un'kaar, nde waa kàsyen wa akà ngwän.
Alɔŋki a Ywan laa bàyi ba muwal ndom ande, waa bàkàdyee ya. Ungö ba bàkàkyään Yɛsu ndaa ayi.
Yɛsu kan'dii baar isii a nsaab tyeen
Mpal kàwem Yɛsu làsaŋ alà, nde kàlwomà kà ikal akin, kàbilà u bwaar, waa kàkyen ikal a mpey. In'sɛŋ a an'bul myàyöb mya, fà an'bul aba, ba bun'läb kà in'kɔl.
Mpal kàtoo Yɛsu u bwaar, nde kàmɛn iköŋ a baar, laa kamɛɛn nde ngyɛb a kölàköl, waa kàkɔɔr an'too aba.
Mpal làbü sisye, alɔŋki bàsin tsütsü apà nde, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Ikal ki kyà ipɔl, taaŋ sye lan'kyà itaan. Apay baar bàkyen ba ŋakwo bàkàsom isa adyà kan'bul. »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Ba mfun akyà yatɛy, lapɛ isa adyà bɛ ŋakwo! »
Wɛɛ ba bàtɛn a nde naa: « Apà bi ibye anà mampà an'tyeen anà nsö yweel mpɛl. »
Nde kàtɛn naa: « Lan'twääl abyà kà. »

Apan, ungö muswaŋ iköŋ a baar mubwaay udu a in'lɛŋ, nde kàwɛl mampà aman man'tyeen anà nsö yàyweel, kàler u du, waa kàsaak bya. Ungö, nde kàtsütsül mampà, waa kàpɛ ma akà alɔŋki, ba waa bàkàkäb ma akà iköŋ a baar.
Baar banswà waa bàdi, waa bàyüür. Ba bàsyen in'lwaŋ kwem aŋiyweel myàŋàyɔl a itiir byàsäl.
Baar bàdi bàkäl isii a abaal nsaab tyeen, ukɔɔn ataŋ akaar anà baan.
Yɛsu wàmuyikyà udu a an'dà
Apan sye, Yɛsu kàswɛŋ alɔŋki mubilà u bwaar ntɔn ba bàfwel u sim, mpal usàpay nde in'sɛŋ.
Ungö kàpay nde iköŋ a baar, nde kàbeenà udu a mɔŋ ntɔn mukàyamà u mpey. Nde kàkäl kwo aŋàyen tii u sisye.
Bwaar làkäl lan'tol kwɛl a mɛɛn, ibɔ a an'dà byàkäl muyisiinà la ntɔn un'pöb kàyee lisà.
Tsütsü a taaŋtyà, Yɛsu kàkyen udu a an'dà mper akà ba.
Umpal bun'mɛn ba wàmuyikyà udu a an'dà, alɔŋki bàkyer atɛɛr, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Wà un'sɔŋà! » Unsà bɔɔmà lanswà, ba bàsi in'kwɛŋ.
Wɛɛ apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làsi un'kanà. Wà mɛ, twon lan'man bɔɔmà! »
Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mwol, kya isàkal ndandaa naa wà ngye, nswɛŋ mɛ in'yi akà ngye udu a an'dà. »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Yà! » Petɔlà waa kàtoo u bwaar, waa kàkyen udu a an'dà mper kàkäl Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ umpal kàmɛn nde un'pöb a ngwal, bɔɔmà làkyer un'kaar. Nde kàsɛmà muminà uboo a an'dà, waa kàsi in'kwɛŋ naa: « Mwol, an'tsü mɔ̈ɔ̈! »
Apan, Yɛsu kàsilà kɔɔ, kun'tɛ mpi, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mbuur a làkwikilà a ikikye! Ntɔn nkye asi ngye nkyɛɛr? »
Umpal bàbilà ba u bwaar, un'pöb waa kànye.
Abun, baar bàkäl uboo a bwaar bàbü an'köm kusà a Yɛsu, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Ndandaa, ngye awà Mwan a Nzam! »
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr abɛy u Ngɛnɛsàlɛr
Ungö bàsabà ba ɛwà, ba bàtöl u Ngɛnɛsàlɛr.
Baar a mper ayin bun'yöb ba, ba bàpay làsaŋ mper yanswà, waa bun'twäälà abɛy banswà.
Ba bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈nà naa nde kapɛ mbwo ba bàbä itàkal làpan a ipfɛy ande mpɛl. Abun, baar bàtɛɛ kya mpi bàkyer akɔɔrà.
